name: @writ/contracts
description: Compact contracts for Writ, the private mandate layer for AI agents on Midnight

scripts.compact: compact compile src/WritRegistry.compact ./src/managed/writ-registry && compact compile src/AuditLog.compact ./src/managed/audit-log
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && cp -Rf ./src/managed ./dist/managed && cp ./src/*.compact ./dist
scripts.ci: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
